scope: Delegation of decisions: civilian authorization, deployment approval, accountability, human review and operational decision workflows.

method.parallelism: This is the assigned delegation research slice. No nested multi-agent tool was available in this session; no independent agent review is claimed.
method.dedup: Reviewed canonical EN event titles, relevant institutional/finance/medicine summaries and caveats, corresponding RU records, both-language full-record keyword matches, and arc theses. Compared substantive workflows and institutional/study families, not merely URLs. None of the six selected event families appears in either canonical file.
method.selection: Six mechanism-distinct recommendations, not a quota: public-sector deployment responsibility, payment review, conditional prescribing authority, explanation/contestability, legal permission for automated decisions, and operational triage with retained human adjudication.
method.authority_rule: Suggestion, case selection, legal permission, conditional future autonomy and exercised final-decision authority are separate. The existing coarse delegation enum is supplemented by authority_boundary below.
method.source_rule: Sources are primary unless explicitly marked otherwise. Official or vendor descriptions establish what was authorized, required or reported, not independent effectiveness. Undated live pages have an empty source date; access date is not substituted for publication date.
limitations: The Utah signed-agreement PDFs returned HTTP 403 through the browsing tool. Nolla's recommendation rests on the inspected regulator register and dated company launch account, not a claimed full-contract review.
The UK legislation HTML was not parseable through the browsing tool; the official Act and commencement PDFs were inspected instead.
No patient-level records, internal decision logs or independent operational audits were inspected. No causal edge or performance validation is proposed.
Several existing military and agent-misbehavior families already cover reversals; no additional military candidate met the novelty threshold in this bounded pass.

candidates.date_basis: Memorandum's issue date on page 1; the February directory is not its publication date. Implementation deadlines are separate.
candidates.title_ru: OMB закрепляет ответственность за внедрение ИИ с существенным воздействием
candidates.title_en: OMB assigns accountability for high-impact AI deployment
candidates.summary_ru: M-25-21 распределяет принятие рисков между ответственными должностными лицами и требует проверки, надзора и прекращения несоответствующего применения ИИ.
candidates.summary_en: M-25-21 distributes risk acceptance to accountable officials and requires testing, oversight and termination of non-compliant AI uses.
candidates.caveat_ru: Это требования к ведомствам, не доказательство соблюдения. Предусмотрены исключения; системы национальной безопасности вне этой сферы.
candidates.caveat_en: Agency requirements, not demonstrated compliance. Waivers exist; national-security systems are outside this scope.
candidates.mechanism_ru: Полномочия внедрять модель и ответственность за риск остаются у людей.
candidates.mechanism_en: Deployment permission and responsibility for accepting risk remain human institutional functions.
actors: US Office of Management and Budget
candidates.authority_boundary: Risk acceptance by officials is not delegated machine authority over citizens.

source_claims.excerpt: risk acceptance, supported by a signature from the individual accepting the risk.
source_claims.claim: Human oversight, signed acceptance and CAIO-controlled waivers belong to the approval workflow. Minimum-practice implementation has a 365-day deadline.

source_claims.locator: Promoting rapid and responsible AI adoption
source_claims.claim: The administration describes a consolidated high-impact category and accelerated adoption; this is policy intent, not an outcome evaluation.

dedup.reason: The existing US record covers M-25-22 procurement/IP portability, not M-25-21 deployment acceptance and waiver authority. Canadian agent guidance is another jurisdiction and instrument.

candidates.date_basis: CMS FAQ retrospectively dates request intake to January 5. Announcement: 2025-06-27; formal model start: 2026-01-01; covered-service cutoff: 2026-01-15. FAQ publication date is unspecified.
candidates.title_ru: WISeR начинает приём запросов: технологии проверяют, клиницисты отвечают за отрицательные заключения
candidates.title_en: WISeR starts request intake with technology-assisted review and clinician-controlled adverse recommendations
candidates.summary_ru: CMS передаёт проверку отдельных услуг Original Medicare технологическим подрядчикам в шести штатах. Отрицательные рекомендации требуют лицензированного клинициста; оплата подрядчиков связана с предотвращёнными расходами.
candidates.summary_en: CMS assigns selected Original Medicare service reviews to technology contractors in six states. Adverse recommendations require licensed clinicians; contractor compensation is linked to averted expenditure.
candidates.caveat_ru: Установленный порядок не подтверждает качество человеческой проверки. Предварительное отрицательное заключение не тождественно окончательному отказу в оплате; сохраняется процедура обжалования.
candidates.caveat_en: The prescribed process does not establish effective human review. Prior non-affirmation is not the final payment denial; administrative appeals remain available.
candidates.mechanism_ru: Автоматизация меняет маршрут допуска к оплате и стимулы проверяющих, не передавая машине право окончательного отказа.
candidates.mechanism_en: Automation changes the payment-review pathway and reviewer incentives without granting machines final denial authority.
candidates.geographic_scope_basis: Original Medicare in New Jersey, Ohio, Oklahoma, Texas, Arizona and Washington; not Medicare Advantage.
candidates.authority_boundary: Organizations receive review duties; licensed clinicians determine adverse recommendations and MAC claim denials trigger appeal rights. No claim of autonomous machine denials.

source_claims.locator: Transition for patients whose care began in 2025; appeal questions
source_claims.excerpt: began accepting prior authorization requests from WISeR providers and suppliers on January 5, 2026
source_claims.claim: Intake and covered-service dates differ; a MAC claim denial, rather than prior non-affirmation itself, is the appealable initial payment determination.

Non-payment recommendations are clinician-determined. Participants receive a performance-adjusted share of expenditures associated with averted inappropriate care. This creates an incentive, not proof of wrongful denial.
Faster review, lower spending and improved experience are program objectives, not measured results in this announcement.

dedup.reason: Neither health-data infrastructure nor bedside clinical decision-support trials covers payment-review delegation and its compensation incentives. Treat WISeR launch, intake and later evaluations as one program family unless an independently verified material intervention merits a new event.

candidates.summary_en: The pilot permits initial prescriptions for a limited topical-acne formulary. Two physicians initially review every prescription; retrospective and sampled review require written state approval.
candidates.caveat_ru: Разрешённая траектория автономии не доказывает переход на поздние этапы. Нет независимых данных об исходах; полный договор не удалось получить.
candidates.caveat_en: An authorized autonomy pathway is not proof of later-stage operation. No independent outcomes were established; the full agreement could not be retrieved.
candidates.mechanism_ru: Регулятор меняет момент обязательной врачебной проверки, сохраняя разрешение перехода между этапами.
candidates.mechanism_en: The regulator controls when mandatory clinical review may move from before issuance to after it.
actors: Utah Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy
candidates.geographic_scope_basis: Utah adults with mild-to-moderate acne; a state-scoped pilot, not nationwide prescribing authority.
candidates.authority_boundary: First-stage output is a proposal requiring physician approval. Later direct issuance is permitted only after a separate written regulatory gate; no such approval was located.

source_claims.excerpt: each requires written approval from this office
source_claims.claim: Relief concerns specified licensing/telehealth enforcement under an agreed protocol, not general immunity. The register requires liability coverage and bars contractual limitations on liability for harm.

The operator describes initial review of 100 patients, subsequent review of up to 500, then at least 10% monthly sampling; transitions depend on safety criteria and state approval. Its clinical-agreement claims are not treated as independently validated outcomes.

The company calls this the nation's first; that priority claim is not adopted.

dedup.reason: Autonomous screening and chatbot trials are not prescribing authorization. Nolla and Doctronic are absent from both canonical files. Select the newer initial-prescription mechanism; retain refill pilots as context rather than populate this packet with every Utah agreement.

candidates.title_ru: Суд ЕС требует понятного объяснения автоматизированной кредитной оценки

candidates.mechanism_ru: Ответственность за результат требует доступного объяснения, а спор о тайне разрешает суд или надзорный орган.
candidates.mechanism_en: Accountability requires usable reasons; courts or supervisors arbitrate competing secrecy claims.

candidates.authority_boundary: Concerns accountability for automated scoring used in a consequential decision, not generative-agent autonomy.

candidates.title_en: UK broadens permitted automated decisions while retaining routes to human review

candidates.summary_en: DUAA section 80 takes effect: significant solely automated decisions using ordinary personal data gain broader lawful grounds, with information, representations, human intervention and contestability safeguards.
candidates.caveat_ru: Не безусловное разрешение: особые категории данных и основание Article 6(1)(ea) ограничены. Изменение закона не доказывает фактическое внедрение.
candidates.caveat_en: Not blanket permission: special-category data and the Article 6(1)(ea) basis remain restricted. A legal change does not demonstrate deployment.
candidates.mechanism_ru: Контроль смещается от узкого перечня разрешений к обязательным средствам пересмотра результата.
candidates.mechanism_en: Control shifts from narrow permissions toward safeguards for challenging automated outcomes.
candidates.authority_boundary: Legal permission for specified automated decisions is distinct from any institution actually delegating its decisions.

source_claims.claim: Section 80 commences on February 5; savings preserve the previous rules for earlier decisions.

source_claims.locator: Section 80; new UK GDPR Articles 22A-22C, printed pages 96-97
source_claims.excerpt: no meaningful human involvement in the taking of the decision

dedup.reason: A change in legal permission for consequential automated decisions, not consultation summarization or a nonbinding financial stress-test proposal. Keep enactment and commencement in one family.
